player.s3.autofix_fail: Could not auto-fix — use the steps below
player.s3.desc: Could not load the file from the S3 bucket. Most often this is CORS configuration or access permissions.
player.s3.reason_auth: Session expired or access denied (401). Refresh the page and log in again.
player.s3.reason_config: Storage is unavailable or keys are invalid (403/404). Check the S3 settings in your profile.
player.s3.reason_media: The file was received but not played back — most often CORS on the bucket or an unsupported codec.
player.s3.reason_network: Network error while requesting a link. Check your internet connection.
player.s3.step1: Open Profile → Storage (BYOS) and check the keys
player.s3.step2: Press Test — this also applies CORS to the bucket
player.s3.step3: Return to the video and press Retry
